title: Short-domain acquisition and corporate identity preservation
intent: Keep Meridian Intelligence as company/public identity while acquiring a short, low-friction, defensible domain.
assumptions: No candidate is declared available, owned or affordable until live authoritative evidence is retrieved
Naming similarity with other organisations triggers legal/trademark review; domain availability alone does not clear a brand

requirements.rule: Normalize candidates via IDNA and canonical lowercase; exclude invalid/confusable/unsupported names before querying
requirements.falsifier: Unicode confusable and empty or malformed names rejected

requirements.rule: Discover TLD RDAP authority through IANA bootstrap/ICANN; record authoritative result, exact query, UTC observation and expiry
requirements.falsifier: Network failure, RDAP 429/500, redaction or a non-authoritative seller result never becomes AVAILABLE

requirements.rule: Retrieve confirmed registrar checkout quotes and renewal rates in USD/GBP incl taxes, currency and premium/transfer costs; expires_at and source URL
requirements.falsifier: Standard .com list price cannot masquerade as a premium domain's actual price

requirements.rule: Compare identity fit, memorability, spelling, existing brand conflicts and investor credibility; cite independently checked UK and relevant international trademark/company sources
requirements.falsifier: Model opinion cannot be labelled legal clearance or measured registration status

requirements.rule: Founder selects exact domain/registrar and approves spend ceiling after evidence; do not infer preference as purchase authorization
requirements.falsifier: No purchase effect without explicit amount/payee/domain-specific approval

effect_boundary: No registration, resale bid, offer, broker contact, DNS mutation, public branding migration or spending without approval
acceptance: A ranked short list with traceable live availability and price or explicit UNKNOWN
One recommended domain conditional on trademark review
A precise payment hold packet with itemized first-year and renewal obligations
Post-purchase independent registrar ownership, renewal lock, DNSSEC and DNS readback as separate proof phase
source_evidence: ICANN RDAP definitive gTLD registration data
